title: 第13章 挑战开始第14章 宁苒苒受伤
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
速度和力量同时增加百分之三十，顿时令大家感觉到自己实力大增。
就在这个时候，赵无极动了，并不是朝着宁苒苒五人冲过来，而是双腿半蹲，双拳同时朝着地面砸下。
朱竹清身影一动，直冲赵无极，赵无极身上肌肉暴涨，伸手就要拽朱竹清的脚，被她一个侧身，凭借速度躲开了。
小舞一个腰弓直击赵无极，谁知她的力量并不足以撼动赵无极，反而被反弹出去，赵无极双腿半蹲，双拳朝着地面砸下。
唐三想起大师说过的话，迅速反应过来赵无极是要对宁荣荣下手，一道蓝黑色的长藤骤然甩出，藤蔓上并没有尖刺，因为它只赋予了唐三第一个魂环的效果，长藤闪电般缠绕上了宁荣荣的腰，唐三在自己跃起的同时，将宁荣荣的身体也带入空中。
“第一魂技，寒冰之焰！”
宁苒苒趁机使用第一魂技，剑刃形状的冰晶里夹杂着炽红的火焰，如同剑羽一般直直射向赵无极，剑刃一碰到赵无极就开始爆炸，绚烂华丽的火花一瞬间绽放，随之一起的是一声声轰鸣的爆炸声。
其他人忘了动作，都被宁苒苒这一手给惊呆了！
“三哥，快！
缠住他！”
唐三立即反应。
下一秒，烟雾退散，赵无极浑身狼狈，衣服变得破破烂烂，显然被炸得不轻。
“你们……很好！”
赵无极阴沉着脸：“竟然可以伤到我，看来我要认真了！”
赵无极大吼一声，身体骤然膨胀。
全身原本就已经恐怖的肌肉几乎膨胀了一倍之多，就连身高也在刹那间拔高一米，整个人都变得极其雄壮起来。
七圈炫丽的魂环同时升起，正像戴沐白所说的那样，两黄、两紫、三黑，七个恐怖的魂环附加在他身上。
唐三甩出蓝银草，将赵无极紧紧缠住，包裹得像一个蓝黑色的大粽子，小舞和朱竹清的反应都很快，小舞正面跃起，朱竹清则从侧面蹿出，同时掠过了震荡。
赵无极突然感觉到自己全身一紧，充满尖刺的藤蔓已经疯狂的缠绕上了他的身体，藤蔓极度收紧，强烈的麻痹性毒素骤然释放。
“当当当——”

那密集的脆响，是朱竹清发动的攻击。
在她刚开始闪出的时候，速度就已经完全展现出来，不愧是敏攻系战魂师，她的速度之快，连戴沐白也有些叹为观止。
最为可怕的是，朱竹清的任何行动都没有一丝声息发出，整个人悄然蹿出，悄然攻击，没有半分能量外放，也没有魂力破空的声。
岂料赵无极很快就将蓝银草崩开，用力抓住朱竹清的脚，将她狠狠的甩了出去。
还是戴沐白及时接住的她，但朱竹清还是肋骨断了两根，昏迷了过去。
小舞脚尖在赵无极肩头轻点，柔软的身体贴着赵无极的背部翻了下去，蝎子辫下探，像一条灵蛇般缠住了赵无极的左脚脚踝处，全身同时用力，但是却没有一丝撼动。
但是小舞的柔技对于赵无极这种力量型魂师来说是最弱的，因为刚好被克制住。
content_en:
The speed and strength increased by 30% at the same time, immediately making everyone feel that their strength had greatly increased.
At this time, Zhao Wuji moved, not rushing towards Ning Ranran and the five others, but squatting with both legs and hitting the ground with both fists at the same time.
Zhu Zhuqing's figure moved and he rushed straight towards Zhao Wuji. Zhao Wuji's muscles swelled and he stretched out his hand to pull Zhu Zhuqing's feet, but she turned sideways and dodged with her speed.
Xiao Wu struck Zhao Wuji directly with a waist bow. Unexpectedly, her strength was not enough to shake Zhao Wuji. Instead, she was bounced away. Zhao Wuji squatted with both legs and smashed his fists towards the ground.
Tang San remembered what the master had said, and quickly realized that Zhao Wuji was going to attack Ning Rongrong. A long blue-black vine suddenly flung out. There were no spikes on the vine, because it only gave Tang San the effect of the first soul ring. The vine wrapped around Ning Rongrong's waist like lightning. As Tang San jumped up, he also brought Ning Rongrong's body into the air.
"The first soul skill, Ice Flame!"
Ning Ranran took the opportunity to use her first soul skill. The ice crystals in the shape of the blade were mixed with blazing red flames, which shot straight towards Zhao Wuji like sword feathers. As soon as the blade touched Zhao Wuji, it began to explode. Gorgeous sparks bloomed in an instant, followed by roaring explosions.
The others forgot about their movements and were all stunned by Ning Ranran's move!
"Third brother, hurry up!
Hang on to him! "
Tang San reacted immediately.
The next second, the smoke dissipated, and Zhao Wuji was in a mess, his clothes became tattered, and he was obviously seriously injured by the explosion.
"You... are very good!"
Zhao Wuji had a sullen face: "You can actually hurt me. It seems I'm going to be serious!"
Zhao Wuji roared, and his body suddenly expanded.
The already terrifying muscles in his body almost doubled in size, and even his height increased by one meter in an instant, making his whole body become extremely majestic.
Seven dazzling soul rings rose up at the same time. Just as Dai Mubai said, two yellow, two purple, and three black, seven terrifying soul rings were attached to him.
Tang San threw out the blue silver grass and wrapped it tightly around Zhao Wuji, wrapping it like a big blue-black rice dumpling. Both Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing reacted very quickly, Xiao Wu jumped up from the front, and Zhu Zhuqing jumped out from the side, passing through the shock at the same time.
Zhao Wuji suddenly felt his whole body tighten, and the vines full of spikes had wrapped around his body crazily. The vines tightened extremely, and the strong paralyzing toxin was suddenly released.
"Dangdangdang——"
The dense crisp sound was Zhu Zhuqing's attack.
When she first started to flash out, her speed was already fully displayed. She was worthy of being an agility-attack war spirit master. Her speed was so fast that even Dai Mubai was a little amazed.
The most frightening thing is that Zhu Zhuqing made no sound at all from any of his actions. He jumped out quietly and attacked quietly without any energy being released, and there was no sound of soul power breaking through the air.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Wuji quickly broke open the blue silver grass, grabbed Zhu Zhuqing's feet, and threw her out.
Dai Mubai caught her in time, but Zhu Zhuqing still broke two ribs and passed out.
Xiao Wu tapped her toes on Zao Wuji's shoulder, her soft body rolled down against Zao Wuki's back, her scorpion braid reached down and wrapped around Zao Wuki's left ankle like a spiritual snake. She exerted all her strength at the same time, but there was no movement at all.
But Xiao Wu's soft skills are the weakest for a powerful soul master like Zhao Wuji, because they are just restrained.
